Technology

From Palworld Wiki
Jump to navigation Jump to search

Technology is a gameplay mechanic, made up of blueprints split between regular Technology and Ancient Technology. Blueprints are unlocked via meeting tiers and using Technology Points and Ancient Technology Points.

The player gains 6 for each level they gain, 1 for each Fast Travel point is unlocked, 1 the first time each  Alpha Pal is defeated, and 5 the first time each  Tower Boss is defeated. As of 0.7.0, a total of 384 can be earned through leveling and 75 from Fast Travel points, and a total of 72 can be earned from Alpha Pals and 35 from Tower Bosses.

Further Technology Points and Ancient Technology Points can be earned from Technical Manuals, available from various sources (including loot and merchants), each of which grant a specific number of one of the two types of points when consumed.

Certain technologies have pre-requisites before they can be unlocked, requiring either a specific  Tower Boss to have been defeated, or a specific  Research to have been completed. Once the pre-requisites are fulfilled, the technology can be unlocked as normal. Technologies that have an unfulfilled pre-requisite note this on the technology tree with a red banner noting what the specific pre-requisite for that technology is.

History

  • 1.0
    • Introduced many new technologies and moved around many of the existing technologies.
  • 0.3.4.0
    • Moved Coal Mine from level 53 to 41.
  • 0.3.1.0
    • Added Pal Dressing Facility, Wall-Mounted Sign, Dazemu Saddle, Glass Structure Set, Yakumo Saddle, Chillet Ignis Saddle, Shroomer Saddle, Shroomer Noct Saddle, Quivern Botan Saddle, Plasteel Armor, Plasteel, Crude Oil Extractor, Ultimate Sphere, Plasteel Helmet, Laser Rifle, Energy Cartridge, Cold Food Box, Xenogard Saddle, Hyper Glider, Flamethrower, Flamethrower Fuel, Refrigerated Crusher, Helzephyr Lux Saddle, Heat Resistant Plasteel Armor, Grenade Launcher, Grenade Ammo, Frag Grenade Mk2, Selyne Saddle, Cold Resistant Plasteel Armor, Gatling Gun, Gatling Gun Bullet, Pal Disassembly Conveyor, Ultra Shield, Lightweight Plasteel Armor, Guided Missile Launcher, Missile Ammo and Blazamut Ryu Saddle to the regular Technology tree.
    • Added Lockpicking Tool v1, Lockpicking Tool v2, Meteor Launcher, Large Power Generator, Lockpicking Tool v3, Sulfur Mine and Coal Mine to the Ancient Technology tree.
    • Moved Antique Couch Set from level 22 to 29.
  • 0.2.0.6
    • Added Ore Mining Site, Ring of Mercy, Antique Dresser, Homeward Thundercloud, Ore Mining Site II, Summoning Altar, Ability Glasses and Electric Egg Incubator to the Ancient Technology tree.
    • Equipment and item stats are now visible on the technology screen, even if you have not unlocked them first.
  • 0.1.2.0
    • Introduced.

Trivia

  • Technologies & Technology Points are likely an blueprint unlocking system inspired from the Engrams & Engram Points system in ARK: Survival Evolved.
